notes.note: This PR changes four behaviours: Claude child work re-keys a backgrounded agent woken again under its original tool_use_id; the idle park counts the engine's latest event as activity and honours the adapter's hasOpenEngineWork veto; Claude session end settles every open task frame unresolved; and the first turn after an engine ended with work running gets an interrupted-work recovery note. Re-read this document's claims that cite the changed sources; none describe these behaviours, so it remains accurate.
